overview.description: SDM makes an almost-perfect copy of your gene with a single intentional point mutation. Use a megaprimer assembled with a backbone, or a round-the-world SDM PCR to remake the backbone too. This is genetic modification - check local rules.
objectives: design mutagenic primers carrying the desired change

instructions.title: Design mutagenic primers
instructions.description: Centre the mismatch within the primer with sufficient flanking complementarity.

instructions.title: Amplify the mutant
instructions.description: Run high-fidelity PCR; for round-the-world, amplify the whole plasmid.

instructions.title: Remove template & screen
instructions.description: DpnI-digest the methylated template, transform, and sequence to confirm the mutation.

submission.description: Introduce a defined point mutation and confirm it by sequencing the screened clone.
